hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash # validate_multi_duplicates.sh # # Jenkins Validation Step: # Checks for duplicate Subject/Sample Multi files in S3. # Fails the build (exit 1) if any duplicates are detected. # # Usage: ./validate_multi_duplicates.sh
set -euo pipefail
# Report file to accumulate errors REPORT_FILE="duplicate_validation_report.txt" echo "--- Duplicate Subject/Sample Multi File Validation Report ---" > "$REPORT_FILE" echo "Generated at: $(date)" >> "$REPORT_FILE" echo "-----------------------------------------------------------" >> "$REPORT_FILE"
# Global failure flag FAILURE_DETECTED=false
# AWS Configuration BUCKET="avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl"
assume_73_role() { aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 3600 \ --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl \ --role-session-name "s3-dbGap-etl" > assume-role-output.txt
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed 's/[ ,"]//g') AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed 's/[ ,"]//g') AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed 's/[ ,"]//g') }
unset_role() { unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN }
log_duplicate() { local label=$1 local ver=$2 local files_list=$3
echo " [FAIL] Duplicate $label files found for version $ver" { echo "STUDY: $stdy_id ($abv_name)" echo "ISSUE: Duplicate $label for Version $ver" echo "FILES FOUND:" echo "$files_list" echo "-----------------------------------------------------------" } >> "$REPORT_FILE"
FAILURE_DETECTED=true }
check_version_duplicates() { local type_name=$1 local files=$2
# 1. Extract distinct versions (e.g. phs000007.v34) # Added '|| true' so grep doesn't exit with 1 if no matches found local versions=$(echo "$files" | grep -o "${stdy_id}\.v[0-9]*" | sort | uniq || true)
for ver in $versions; do if [[ -z "$ver" ]]; then continue; fi
# Filter files belonging to this version (exact match on version segment) local ver_files=$(echo "$files" | grep -F "${ver}." || true)
# 2. Check for duplicate Data files (.txt) # Added '|| true' to prevent crash if no .txt files are found local txt_files=$(echo "$ver_files" | grep -i "\.txt$" || true) local txt_count=$(echo "$txt_files" | grep -c "^" || true)
if [[ "$txt_count" -gt 1 ]]; then log_duplicate "$type_name (Data/TXT)" "$ver" "$txt_files" fi
# 3. Check for duplicate Data Dictionaries (.xml) # Added '|| true' to prevent crash if no .xml files are found local xml_files=$(echo "$ver_files" | grep -i "\.xml$" || true) local xml_count=$(echo "$xml_files" | grep -c "^" || true)
if [[ "$xml_count" -gt 1 ]]; then log_duplicate "$type_name (Dictionary/XML)" "$ver" "$xml_files" fi done }
# --- Main Execution ---
assume_73_role
echo "Fetching Managed_Inputs.csv..." mkdir -p data aws s3 cp "s3://${BUCKET}/general/resources/Managed_Inputs.csv" data/ --no-progress
# Ensure csvcut is available if ! command -v csvcut &> /dev/null; then echo "Error: csvcut is required but not installed. Install csvkit." exit 1 fi
echo "Parsing input CSV..." csvcut -c "Study Abbreviated Name","Study Identifier","Study Type","Data is ready to process","Data Processed","Has Multi" data/Managed_Inputs.csv | tail -n +2 > inputs.csv
echo "Starting Validation Loop..."
while IFS=',' read -r abv_name stdy_id stdy_type data_ready data_processed has_multi do # Cleanup quotes and whitespace if csvcut output includes them abv_name=$(echo "$abv_name" | tr -d '"') stdy_id=$(echo "$stdy_id" | tr -d '"') data_ready=$(echo "$data_ready" | tr -d '"') has_multi=$(echo "$has_multi" | tr -d '"')
# macOS/Linux compatible lowercase data_ready_lower=$(echo "$data_ready" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]') has_multi_lower=$(echo "$has_multi" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]') abv_name_lower=$(echo "$abv_name" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
# Filter logic: Data Ready=yes AND Has Multi=yes if [[ "$data_ready_lower" == "yes" ]] && [[ "$has_multi_lower" == "yes" ]]; then
echo "Validating: $abv_name ($stdy_id)..." s3_path="s3://${BUCKET}/${abv_name_lower}/decoded_data/"
# 1. Get full file list (suppress errors if folder doesn't exist) if full_file_list=$(aws s3 ls "$s3_path" --recursive 2>/dev/null); then # 2. Process Subject Files # CRITICAL FIX: Added '|| true' to prevent exit 1 when no files match subject_files=$(echo "$full_file_list" | grep -i "subject\.multi" || true) if [[ -n "$subject_files" ]]; then check_version_duplicates "SUBJECT" "$subject_files" fi
# 3. Process Sample Files # CRITICAL FIX: Added '|| true' to prevent exit 1 when no files match sample_files=$(echo "$full_file_list" | grep -i "sample\.multi" || true) if [[ -n "$sample_files" ]]; then check_version_duplicates "SAMPLE" "$sample_files" fi else echo " [WARN] Could not list $s3_path (folder might not exist yet)" fi fi done < inputs.csv
unset_role
# --- Final Decision --- if [ "$FAILURE_DETECTED" = true ]; then echo "" echo "!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!" echo "FAILURE: Duplicate files detected. Pipeline stopping." echo "!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!" echo "" cat "$REPORT_FILE" exit 1 else echo "" echo "SUCCESS: No duplicates found." exit 0 fi
